title: Tech & architecture slides for the Varma deck
subtitle: Two slides for deck-writer to insert after the answer-first slide

slides.title: One MLOps golden path replaces twenty one-off deployment scripts
bullets: Every model, current and future, uses the same repo template, configuration schema, pipeline and monitoring. A new use case starts from the template, not from a blank script.
Built on your existing cloud data platform; MLflow-compatible registry, so the pattern is not tied to one vendor.

diagram.band: Models support pension decisions, they do not make them: human approval stays in the process, and explanations are logged

slides.title: Use case 1 in production by month 2; your new specialists ship use case 3 themselves
table: Use case 1 on the golden path (quick win)
Use case 2 on the same template
Use case 3 + triage of the other ~17 experiments
Handover check: your team releases unaided
slides.note: Technical unknowns we price in: which of the three use cases has production-ready data; access to personal data for training (minimised, pseudonymised); EU AI Act classification per use case. Documentation uses Finnish pension terms (työeläke, TyEL, eläkepäätös), no translation needed.
